description: Field-lineage registry for parcel_maxbld_scenarios (Spec 78 §Phase-5 P5.10, P5.15). One entry per field: scenarios, by-law regulation_ids, keyed unit ids / Layer 2 targets (or OWED with owner), input columns (table.column + migration), logic variables, trust tier, invariants. scripts/analysis/bylaw/generate-maxbld-lineage.mjs validates it and renders the Spec 78 P5.10 table and the P5.15 invariant table inside generated markers (R-BF: never hand-kept). Edit this file, then run the generator with --write.

trust_tiers.bylaw_derived: high: by-law (through Layer 2) + lot geometry + declared logic variables only
trust_tiers.estimate: low, user-correctable: reads an estimated input (existing-house massing, neighbour setbacks, lane edges)
trust_tiers.user_input: needs the owner's entry (existing house); NULL in the pipeline when the entry is required
trust_tiers.precedent_estimate: CoA tier: calibrated from realized CoA builds (M-65), never law; kept apart from the as-of-right numbers
trust_tiers.observed: empirical context (norms, comps, applications), never a multiplier

invariants.statement: Identity: `total_gfa = main_gfa_with_suite + suite_gfa` (new build); RA `existing + addition_up + addition_back`.
`suite_gfa ≤ main_gfa_with_suite − suite_gfa_strict_margin` (exists as `suite_lt_main`).
`main_gfa_with_suite ≤ main_gfa_without_suite` (a suite never enlarges the main).
`gain_vs_detached_* ≥ 0` whenever both rows are permitted (release only removes limits).
Houseplex GFA ≥ detached GFA on the same lot when both are permitted.
`gain_reasons = none` ⇒ `gain_vs_detached_gfa = 0`.
`fsi_status = applies:v` ⇒ `main_gfa ≤ v × lot_size_sqm` above grade (exists as `fsi_consistent`).
Footprint ≤ coverage × lot where coverage applies; garden option A total ≤ 45 %, option B ancillary ≤ 20 %; laneway ancillary ≤ 30 % (`coverage_consistent`).
Every setback used ≥ the Layer 2 minimum for that class; front ≥ the averaged value; ≥ 2.5 m from a lane centreline.

`main_height ≤ height_m`; `main_storeys ≤ height_storeys` unless not_applicable; `suite_height ∈ {4.0, 6.3}`; outside the Coxwell polygon `suite_separation ≥ 7.5 ⇔ suite_height > 4.0`, inside it `≥ 5.0`.
`dwelling_units ≤ min(u [no 'u' = no cap; lifted to 6 only in R/RT/RM inside 600.60], 4 [S always], 6 iff gis_in and detached, floors)` (M-202); `dwelling_units ≥ 2` on H/S (`units_within_cap`).
`Σ unit_breakdown.interior_area ≤ (Σ plates + basement_livable) × (1 − circulation_share)`.
`suite_interior ≤ 0.45 × house_interior` (M-199), or the whole basement of a one-storey house.
`max_bedrooms = 4 × units` at 2 units, `3 × units` at ≥ 3.
`suite_type = laneway` ⇒ a 150.8.30.20(1) arm passed (rear, side or cumulative ≥ 3.5 m).
Every `cited_clauses` entry exists in `bylaw-provisions.json`.
Every numeric output traces to an applied Layer 2 unit id or a P5.9 logic variable (the lineage registry names one for every field; G-EXC-LIT / compute-literals scan the code).
No applied unit comes from a non-residential chapter (M-159(1); would have caught M-217) and no excluded-use unit (M-225) enters a suite target.
invariants.runs_at: test `bylaw-evaluator-fixes.logic.test.ts` › "INV-18 — …" (by-law evaluator lane, green 2026-10-20) + step guard on the Layer 2 rows

invariants.statement: No `not_evaluated:no_candidate` on a target whose article does not exist in that zone (R coverage, R/RT length, RT/RM-houseplex depth, main walls with the roof-slope condition) — those are `unregulated` / `not_applicable` (M-218, M-220).
invariants.runs_at: test `bylaw-evaluator-fixes.logic.test.ts` › "INV-19 — …" (M-218 and the M-220 label arm, green 2026-10-20) and › "INV-19 open arm …" (the absent-article cells, a ratchet; at 0 since 2026-10-20, 69a M-240) + step check

invariants.statement: Renovation columns NULL unless the scenario is a renovation; `existing_storeys` NULL on every pipeline row (user input only, O-13).
Gates: `zoning_holding` ⇒ new-build `not_permitted:holding_zone`; every `gate_flags` value has its disclosure code; front lot line < 3.5 m ⇒ `not_buildable:10.5.30.20(2)`.
`row_trust_level` equals the P5.14 computation over the row's own `trust_checks` (never asserted).
CoA tier apart: `coa_*` fields never feed `total_gfa_sqm`, `is_headline` or any as-of-right field; `coa_gfa_sqm = main_gfa_sqm × u` or NULL with a `coa_status` reason.
Every P5.10 field is in the lineage registry with resolvable regulation ids, migration columns and logic variables (seeded or OWED); the P5.10 table is generated from it.

Every operator envelope answer has a disposition (matches → unit exists; wrong → every fix id cited by a keyed correction, or a verified named lock (LC-53); disclose → P5.12 code; unsure/null → OPEN with its question).
